units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Yoma 3:2:2">Y. Yoma III, beg. 40ᵇ</cite> <he>מאור החמה פּוֹסֶה וכ׳</he> the light of the sun (dawn) spreads over the whole eastern horizon, opp. <he>מתמר ועולה</he>. Ib. 41ᵃ bot. <he>של בית היתה מתמרת … ופוֹסָה ויורדת וכ׳ …</he> the frankincense of Beth Abtinas rose straight in a colunn and then spread and came down &c.; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shekalim 5:2:5">Y. Shek. V, 49ᵃ</cite> top; <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 1:14">Cant. R. to I, 14</cite>; <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 3:6">III, 6</cite>.

<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 4:14">Ib. to IV, 14</cite> (ref. to <he>ואהלות</he> <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 4:14">ib.</cite>) [read:] (<cite ref="P01088"><he>עץ</he></cite>) <he>שהוא פוסה כאהל</he> a tree which spreads like a tent.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 15:6">Gen. R. s. 15</cite> (ref. to <he>עץ החיים</he>, <cite ref="Genesis 2:9">Gen. II, 9</cite>) <he>עץ שהוא פוסה על פני וכ׳</he> a tree which spread over all living things.

<cite ref="Mishnah Negaim 4:8">Neg. IV, 8</cite>, a. fr. <he>ופָשְׂתָה וכ׳</he> and the spot spread &c.; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Moed Katan 1:5:2">Y. M. Kat. I, 80ᶜ</cite> bot. <he>ופָסְתָה</he>; a. fr.
